newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ridgefield, Conn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ridgefield, Conn.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Town of Ridgefield
Connecticut
General Obligation Bonds
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Town of
Ridgefield, Connecticut, at Town of Ridgefield, Town Hall,
400 Main Street, First Floor Conference Room, Ridgefield,
Connecticut 06877, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Standard Time)
on
Thursday, November 14, 1996,
for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and
accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of
delivery, of the whole of $6,020,000 General Obligation
Bonds, Issue of 1996, payable on November 15 in each year as
follows: $325,000 in each of the years 1998 through 1999,
$375,000 in each of the years 2000 through 2001, $420,000 in
the year 2002, $450,000 in each of the years 2003 through
2005, and $475,000 in each of the years 2006 through 2011.
Bonds maturing after November 15, 2005 are subject to
redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the Town, on
or after November 15, 2005. The Bonds will be qualified
tax-exempt obligations'', will be certified by Fleet
National Bank, Hartford, Connecticut, and delivered against
payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about
November 25, 1996, subject to the approving opinion of Day,
Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be
issued by means of a book-entry system with The Depository
Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities
depository.
Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the Town's Official
Statement may be obtained from Ms. Janette J. Marcoux,
Managing Director, Independent Bond and Investment
Consultants, 273 Battle Street, Bristol, Connecticut 06010
Maureen M. Kiernan, Treasurer
(From The Bond Buyer)
